title: De week dat niks meer werkt
content:
In 'De week dat niks meer werkt' onderzoeken journalist Sophie Derkzen en advocaat en privacy/cybersecurity-expert Ot van Daalen hoe kwetsbaar Europa is geworden door zijn afhankelijkheid van technologie uit de VS en China.

title: Ot van Daalen appointed Professor of Privacy and AI Law at the Amsterdam Business School
content:
IViR is pleased to announce that Ot van Daalen has been appointed full professor of ‘Privacy and Artificial Intelligence Law’ at the Amsterdam Business School of the University of Amsterdam. Ot will continue to work at IViR one day a week.

title: Introducing…Marie-Therese Sekwenz
content:
Marie-Therese Sekwenz is a postdoctoral researcher at IViR. She works with João Pedro Quintais on the NWO Vidi project Generative AI Content Moderation: Regulation for Fundamental Rights, which examines how EU law can address the moderation of generative AI content while protecting fundamental rights, particularly freedom of expression.
